answer: Identities funded from a common source within 43 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the forge graph is rebuilt each epoch, the signal merge is applied at settlement and the lotus audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
